annotations.title: Check where a video ad stands

description: Returns the state of an ad started with create_ad: building, preview_ready, paid, failed or unavailable, with its page link, the changes left and the reason for a failure. Use it when the user asks whether their ad is ready, or before saying that it is. To wait for an ad being built, pass wait_seconds and call again while the status is building.

wait_seconds.description: Holds the answer up to this long, returning as soon as the ad stops building. Default 0: answer at once.

name: get_ad_status

ad_id.description: The latest version of the ad. A change makes a new version.

failure.description: Why the ad, or the last change to it, failed.

title: Check where a video ad stands
